questions.q: Why do many successful people exercise or meditate right after waking?
a: It boosts the brain and sets up the rest of the day
It replaces the need for a full night of sleep
It is the only way to avoid morning distractions
It lets them finish work before breakfast
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the surveyed high achievers see movement as boosting the brain and setting them up to win the day.

questions.q: What did Nir Eyal do to protect his sleep?
a: He set his router to cut the internet at 10 pm
He set three alarms across the room
He stopped eating dinner after 6 pm
He moved his phone into the bathroom
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes Eyal's router shutting off the internet at 10 pm so he is off devices before bed.

questions.q: What evening rule does Jenny Blake follow to disconnect from work?
a: She does not check email after 5 pm
She writes tomorrow's plan at midnight
She leaves her laptop at the office
She turns off all lights by 8 pm
questions.why: Lesson 2 uses Blake's no-email-after-5-pm rule as an example of disconnecting in the evening.

questions.q: What happened to Arianna Huffington that changed her view of sleep?
a: She collapsed at work and broke her cheekbone
She was diagnosed with chronic insomnia
She missed a flight after oversleeping
She fell asleep during a live interview
questions.why: Lesson 3 recounts Huffington passing out at her desk from exhaustion and breaking her cheekbone.

questions.q: What benefit does the summary link to giving up your alarm clock?
a: Better sleep and, for one investor, relief from depression
More hours available for early exercise
A sharper memory for daily tasks
A reduced need for evening planning
questions.why: Lesson 3 says Brad Feld stopped using an alarm after poor sleep fed a depressive episode and felt better.
